versions.changelog: Add scope collapse guard. Add QUICKSTART.md.
Replace the duplicated all-in-one controller with a specialist router and one-writer authority model.

- Initial public release of AI Workflow Operating System (v1.0.0), a unified bilingual master skill.
- Combines project lifecycle planning, project memory, task handoff, knowledge intake governance, cross-source synthesis, and audit tracking in a single workflow.
- Integrates and replaces previous Project Lifecycle Navigator, Daily Workflow, and Web Search Rules skills.
- Introduces robust modules for handling knowledge sources, trust levels, intake statuses, and project handoff.
- Supports a wide range of source types and detailed intake, review, and archive rules.
- Includes comprehensive safety, confirmation, and audit requirements; bilingual documentation and guidance throughout.
